title: Sweetwater Grade 2 lesson plan
scope: Excerpts only: the lesson-content lines that ClassThread items cite, copied from the posted K-5 lesson plan with the teachers' permission. No names, rosters, small-group links or student information are stored.
content:
[Oct 26 | Social Studies 10.26-10.30, standard] SS2G1.a Locate and compare the geographic regions of Georgia: Blue Ridge, Piedmont, Coastal Plain, Ridge and Valley, and Appalachian Plateau.
[Oct 26 | Social Studies, Monday 10/26] Explain that a region is an area that shares certain characteristics.
[Oct 26 | Social Studies, Thursday 10/29] Explain that the Piedmont has rolling hills and that the Coastal Plain is generally flatter, with broad areas of low-lying land.
